intro:
2027 is shaping up to be one of the biggest years for new cars in Australia. A 300kW plug-in hybrid Nissan Navara with 3,500kg towing, utes from GAC and Hyundai, a cheaper Toyota RAV4 plug-in hybrid, the return of the Mitsubishi Pajero, and new EVs from BYD, Mazda, BMW and Honda. Here are 10 new cars coming to Australia for 2027 that could shake up the market – with confirmed specs, prices where announced, and clearly labelled estimates.

Launch dates and prices can change. Prices marked as estimates come from the motoring media, not the car makers.
